title: kit.health.v1
description: The answer of GET /api/health on a kit site Worker (@saasreport/cloudflare/health): derived from the site's own monitor (its MONITOR service binding, GET /status, kit.monitor-status.v1), never a constant. `ok` is true only when the monitor's latest run is passing and not stale; HTTP 200 then, 503 otherwise (failing, stale, unknown, a monitor that does not answer or is not bound). Facts the site adds (component, feature switches) ride along under their own keys and never decide `ok`.

last.description: started_at of the monitor's latest run.

failed.description: Names of the journeys that failed in the latest run.
